about.title: YapYap
about.disclaimer: YapYap is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

newChat.title: New chat
newChat.numberLabel: Phone number, with the country code
newChat.numberHint: Start with + or 00 and the country code. YapYap does not save the number.
newChat.notReady: WhatsApp is not ready to open the chat. Try again.

picker.title: Choose what to share
picker.noSources: No screens or windows can be shared right now.
picker.nothing: Nothing can be shared right now.

unsupported.title: WhatsApp says this browser is not supported
unsupported.advice: Clearing the cache usually fixes this. If it does not, check for a YapYap update.

blank.title: WhatsApp did not finish loading
blank.advice: Try again. If the page stays blank, clearing the cache usually fixes it.

load-failed.title: WhatsApp could not be reached
load-failed.advice: Check your internet connection, then try again.

crashed.title: WhatsApp keeps stopping
crashed.advice: Try again. If it keeps happening, clearing the cache usually helps.

recovery.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
recovery.keepsLogin: Clearing the cache keeps you logged in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: These settings were saved by a newer version of YapYap, so they cannot be changed here.
settings.restartNeeded: Restart YapYap to apply your changes.
settings.waylandPlacement: On Wayland, your desktop decides where windows go.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save your settings to a file, or bring them over from another computer. The file never includes your WhatsApp login or chats.
backup.exportFailed: Could not save the settings file.
backup.notSettings: That file is not a YapYap settings file.
backup.damaged: YapYap could not read that file. It may be damaged.
backup.newer: Those settings come from a newer version of YapYap. Update YapYap to import them.
backup.replaces: Your current settings will be replaced.
backup.invalidValues_one: 1 invalid value in the file will use the default instead.
backup.invalidValues_other: {{count}} invalid values in the file will use the default instead.

loadNotices.restored: Your settings file was damaged, so YapYap restored the last good copy.
loadNotices.defaults: Your settings file was damaged, so YapYap started with default settings.
loadNotices.newer: Your settings come from a newer version of YapYap, so this version will not change them.
loadNotices.reset: Some settings were invalid and were reset to their defaults.

problems.autostartFailed: Your system did not let YapYap start at login. Check the login or startup items in your system settings.
problems.autostartUnsupported: This package cannot start YapYap at login yet. Add YapYap to the startup applications in your system settings instead.

startMinimized.label: Start minimized
startMinimized.description: Open YapYap in the background, in the tray or the Dock. Starting it again shows the window.

autostart.label: Start at login
autostart.description: Start YapYap when you log in to this computer.

betaUpdates.label: Get beta updates
betaUpdates.description: Try each version a few days before its release and help find problems. Betas can be less stable; turning this off waits for the next release rather than going back.

doNotDisturb.label: Do not disturb
doNotDisturb.description: Show no notifications at all, and play no sounds from accounts that are not on screen. Unread counts still update.

quickPanel.label: Quick access panel
quickPanel.description: A small window that stays on top of other apps, to switch accounts and turn Do not disturb on or off.

quickPanelPlace.label: Quick access panel position
quickPanelPlace.description: Where the panel sits on your main screen.

closeToTray.label: Close to the tray
closeToTray.description: Closing the window keeps YapYap running in the tray, so notifications keep coming. Quit from the tray or the menu.

enabled.label: Check spelling
enabled.description: Underline misspelled words as you type, in your system’s language. On Windows and Linux, turning this on downloads that language’s dictionary from Google once.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Applies to YapYap and to WhatsApp, as long as WhatsApp’s own theme is set to System default.

autoHideMenuBar.label: Hide the menu bar
autoHideMenuBar.description: Press Alt to show it when you need it.

trayIcon.label: Tray icon
trayIcon.description: A one-color icon matches the other icons in your panel or menu bar. Automatic picks the shade that stands out against it.

zoom.label: Interface scale
zoom.description: How large WhatsApp appears. View → Zoom In and Zoom Out go in finer steps, up to 300%.

pinchZoom.label: Zoom with a pinch, or Ctrl and the wheel
pinchZoom.description: Turn this off if you zoom by accident on a touchpad. The View menu and its shortcuts still zoom.

compactSidebar.label: Compact account sidebar
compactSidebar.description: Show only the color and initial of each account in the sidebar, which appears when several accounts run.

hardwareAcceleration.label: Use hardware acceleration
hardwareAcceleration.description: Uses the graphics card to draw YapYap. Turn this off if the window flickers or stays blank.

displayBackend.label: Display backend
displayBackend.description: How YapYap talks to your display server. Try the other one if the window is blank, blurry or misplaced.

diskCacheMb.label: Disk cache size
diskCacheMb.description: How much disk space WhatsApp’s files may take in the cache. Smaller saves space; WhatsApp may load a little slower. Takes effect after a restart.

jsHeapMb.label: Memory limit per page
jsHeapMb.description: The most memory WhatsApp’s scripts may use in one account. Raise it if a large account crashes; lower it to save memory. Takes effect after a restart.

hardwareVideoDecoding.label: Use hardware video decoding
hardwareVideoDecoding.description: Uses the graphics card to play videos and video calls. Turn this off if video stutters or shows artifacts.

crashReports.label: Crash reports
crashReports.description: After YapYap closes unexpectedly, keep a redacted report on this computer. Nothing is sent unless you choose to report it on GitHub.

options.ask: Keep a report and offer to review it

notificationSender.label: Show who wrote in notifications
notificationSender.description: Turn this off to show “WhatsApp” instead of the contact or group, for example when others can see your screen.

notificationText.label: Show message text in notifications
notificationText.description: Turn this off to show “New message” instead. The text then never reaches your system’s notifications.

blurWhenUnfocused.label: Blur WhatsApp when YapYap is not in front
blurWhenUnfocused.description: Hides your chats whenever another window is in front of YapYap. Click YapYap to see them again.

blurWhenIdle.label: Blur WhatsApp when you are away
blurWhenIdle.description: Hides your chats after five minutes without using your computer, until you are back.

unreadWhileHidden.label: Keep chats unread while YapYap is hidden
unreadWhileHidden.description: When YapYap is hidden or minimized, WhatsApp does not mark new messages in the open chat as read. Turn this off to let the open chat keep reading.

proxyMode.label: Proxy
proxyMode.description: How YapYap connects. If a proxy cannot be used, YapYap stops connecting rather than going around it.

proxyServer.label: Proxy address
proxyServer.description: Used when Proxy is set to “This proxy”: http://, https:// or socks5://, a host and a port. Press Enter to save it.

developerMode.label: Developer Mode
developerMode.description: Lets you install unsigned extensions while you write them. Nobody vouches for an unsigned extension, so YapYap marks it wherever it appears.

chatMessages.label: Messages an extension may read
chatMessages.description: How many of the open chat’s latest messages an extension you allowed to read chats receives when it asks.

askWhere.label: Ask where to save each file
askWhere.description: Off saves files straight to your Downloads folder. On asks each time, starting in the folder you last chose.

folder.label: Save files to
folder.description: Where files go when YapYap does not ask.

openWhenDone.label: Open files when they finish downloading
openWhenDone.description: Opens PDFs, pictures, sound, video and text in their usual app. Anything that could run a program is only saved.

folder.label: Save recordings to
folder.description: Where YapYap keeps the calls you record. If the folder is gone, recordings go to the default folder again.

welcome.title: Welcome to YapYap
welcome.intro: A few choices to start with. You can change any of them later in Settings, and skip this with Escape.
welcome.guide: New to YapYap? Read the six-step guide
welcome.languageNote: YapYap is in English for now. More languages are on their way.
welcome.notificationsNote: YapYap shows WhatsApp’s notifications as your system’s own. The first time, your system may ask whether YapYap may show them.

trace.confirmDetail: For 10 seconds, YapYap records where its time goes: pages, scripts, layout and drawing. Do whatever is slow during that time. The trace holds the addresses of the pages and files YapYap loads, but no messages, memory dumps or screenshots. It is saved where you choose, and nothing is sent.
trace.savedDetail: Attach it to a bug report if you choose to. Open it in the Perfetto trace viewer.
trace.failed: The performance trace could not be recorded.

report.title: Report a Problem
report.intro: Describe what went wrong. YapYap sends nothing: it copies the report and opens GitHub in your browser, where you can edit it before you submit it.
report.placeholder: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead
report.diagnosticsHint: Versions, your system, graphics and the end of YapYap’s log, with phone numbers and other personal details removed. Never your messages.
report.opened: The report is on your clipboard, and GitHub is open in your browser.
report.failed: Could not open GitHub. Copy Diagnostics from the Help menu instead.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Each account uses one of WhatsApp’s linked-device slots for its number.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.muteHint: A muted account shows no notifications and plays no sounds while it is not on screen.
accounts.runHint: An account that is off keeps its login and data on this computer, but receives no messages until you turn it on again.
accounts.proxyHint: Empty uses the proxy in Settings → Network. Otherwise http://, https:// or socks5://, a host and a port; calls then go only through it.
accounts.proxyInvalid: Use http://, https:// or socks5://, then a host and a port, such as socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
accounts.refused: At least one account must keep running, so this one cannot be turned off.
accounts.failed: Could not save the account. Try again.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.notificationsState: Allowed; mute the account to silence them
permissions.forget: Ask Again for Camera and Microphone

discard.message: Discard your changes to this account?

assistantBar.label: AI suggestions
assistantBar.writePlaceholder: Say what you want to write, such as “I’ll be ten minutes late”
assistantBar.chatChanged: You opened another chat, so these suggestions are gone. Ask again here.

extensions.stopped: {{extension}} kept using too much of your computer, so YapYap stopped it. Install it again to start it.
extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.hint: Each extension runs in its own sandbox and can do only what you allowed when you installed it.
extensions.pulled: The marketplace pulled this version, so it does not run: {{reason}} Remove it, or install another version from the Marketplace tab.
extensions.developerMode: Developer Mode is on, so unsigned extensions can be installed. Turn it off in Settings when you no longer need it.

result.failed: The extension could not be installed. Try again.

consent.author: By {{name}}
consent.reviewed: YapYap reviewed this version for the marketplace. A review looks for harmful or undeclared behavior; it is not a guarantee.
consent.updateAsks: This update asks for more than before:
consent.risk: YapYap has not reviewed this extension. Install it only if you trust its author: you install it at your own risk.
consent.unsignedRisk: Nobody signed this extension, so nothing shows who made it or that it is unchanged. Install it only if you wrote it yourself.
consent.acknowledge: I understand that I install this extension at my own risk

extensions.settingRefused: Not saved: YapYap could not use this value
extensions.permissionsHint: Turn off anything you no longer want this extension to do. Turning something back on gives back only what you allowed when you installed it.

capabilities.chat:read-active: Read the messages of the chat you have open
capabilities.chat:read-unread-summary: See which chats have unread messages
capabilities.composer:insert-draft: Write drafts in the message box, which you send yourself
capabilities.local-network: Connect to servers running on this computer, such as a local AI model
capabilities.composer:read-draft: Read what you type in the message box
capabilities.storage:local: Keep its own data on this computer
capabilities.secrets:own: Keep its own secrets, such as API keys, encrypted
capabilities.assistant:bar: Show suggestions beneath your chats, which only you can send, with a click
capabilities.calls:record: Ask to record your calls; YapYap records only when you click Record, and the extension never gets the recording

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.hint: What each extension asked YapYap to do, and how it went. YapYap never records what an extension sent or received.
activity.empty: No extension has asked for anything yet.

marketplace.unreachable: The marketplace could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
marketplace.invalid: The marketplace sent a list YapYap could not verify, so nothing is shown. Try again later.
marketplace.outdated: The marketplace list is out of date, so nothing is shown. Try again later.
marketplace.privacy: YapYap downloads the marketplace list only while this tab is open, without saying who you are.
marketplace.mismatch: The download does not match what the marketplace lists, so it was not installed.
marketplace.unlisted: The marketplace does not list this extension for this version of YapYap.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.empty: Nothing downloaded yet in this session.
downloads.kept: YapYap keeps this list only while it runs.

customCode.title: Custom CSS and JavaScript
customCode.warning: Advanced. This code runs in WhatsApp and can read your chats. Only add code you understand, and never paste code someone sent you.
customCode.cssHint: WhatsApp shows your CSS as you type. It is kept only when you save.
customCode.jsHint: Runs when WhatsApp loads, after the code for all accounts, apart from WhatsApp’s own scripts. Reload WhatsApp to run a change.

shortcuts.globalHint: These work while you use other apps. They have no keys until you give them some.
shortcuts.notRegistered: Another app already uses those keys, or this system does not let apps use keys everywhere.
shortcuts.press: Press the new keys, or Escape to keep these
shortcuts.invalid: Use a key together with a modifier such as Ctrl, Alt, Shift or ⌘, or a function key alone.
shortcuts.switchEndsInOne: Switching accounts needs keys that end in 1, as it takes 1 to 9.
shortcuts.taken: Those keys are already used for “{{action}}”.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts

actions.switchAccount: Switch to the first account; 2 to 9 switch to the next ones
actions.privacyScreen: Turn the privacy screen on or off
actions.toggleWindow: Show or hide YapYap, from any app

spellingLanguages.title: Spelling languages
spellingLanguages.off: Spell checking is off. Turn it on in Settings → Spelling; the languages you choose here apply once it is on.
spellingLanguages.download: On Windows and Linux, each language’s dictionary is downloaded from Google the first time it is used.
spellingLanguages.noSystem: No dictionary matches your system’s language. Choose one below.
spellingLanguages.macos: macOS checks spelling in the languages chosen in System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input.

proxyLogin.title: Sign in to the proxy
proxyLogin.asks: The proxy {{host}} asks for a username and password.
proxyLogin.failed: The proxy did not accept that username and password. Try again.
proxyLogin.rememberHint: Kept encrypted by your system’s keychain.
proxyLogin.cannotRemember: This computer has no keychain YapYap can use, so the password is asked for each time.

extensionHost.detail: The extension wants to send data there and read the answer. Only allow a host you trust, such as a service you set up for this extension.

removeExtension.detail: This stops the extension and deletes it, with its settings, its stored data and its saved secrets, such as API keys. Its past activity stays listed.

resetSession.detail: This logs you out and deletes WhatsApp’s data on this computer. Your chats stay on your phone. To use WhatsApp here again, link this device again.

removeAccount.detail: This logs the account out and deletes its WhatsApp data on this computer. Its chats stay on your phone.

unsafeStart.message: YapYap cannot start safely on this system
unsafeStart.detail: YapYap cannot start safely: its sandbox is turned off. On Ubuntu 24.04 and later this happens with the AppImage, because the system restricts unprivileged user namespaces. Install the .deb, .rpm or Flatpak package instead, or allow the AppImage with an AppArmor profile. YapYap never runs without its sandbox.

crashReview.detail:
This report was saved on this computer and has not been sent anywhere. Report on GitHub opens a prefilled bug report for you to review and submit.

{{report}}

installUpdate.detail: It was downloaded and verified. Restart YapYap to install it now, or keep working and install it later.

media.detail: YapYap remembers your answer until you quit.
media.systemRefused: macOS does not let YapYap use your {{device}}.
media.systemRefusedDetail: Allow YapYap in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then try again.

notices.safeMode: YapYap started in safe mode, without hardware acceleration.
notices.gpuCrashes: Graphics kept crashing, so YapYap started without hardware acceleration this time.
notices.whatsAppReloaded: WhatsApp stopped unexpectedly and was reloaded.
notices.newRelease: YapYap {{version}} is available. Click to open its download page.

recording.consentHint: Ask everyone on the call before you record it.

consent.detail: In many places it is against the law to record a call without the consent of everyone on it. Ask the people on the call before you record, and keep the recording to yourself. YapYap saves recordings only on this computer.
consent.checkbox: I know the law where I and the people I call are may require everyone's consent, and I will ask for it
